basis: Hand derivation from the pinned grammar.js alone (the grammar.js the kind map pins) of the node type at the witness of each B alternative of csharp-B03 and csharp-B04, and of the type of each anchor lexeme of the A alternatives, written without reading the kind map, the expected types, the Roslyn kinds or any native output. A row states the class of the derivation, the derived types, the node types of the same extent that the expected types may also list, and grammar quotes. The verifier recomputes the comparison with the expected types. The findings are the alternatives the first comparison did not match; the derivation was fixed before the seal and each fix is stated. The audit covers the types only; the position of the witness is the position audit, and a derivation is what one reader derived from the grammar text, not a parser run.

findings.fix: kind map r3 splits the 1:n entry of SimpleAssignmentExpression by the parent kind WithInitializerExpression

findings.what: the expected types held local_function_statement as well, which the witness `var a = 1;` is not
